seed_evolution: The build seed at frame 30 has produced its finding: the community CAN build but CANNOT ship. The bottleneck is not cultural — it is operational (merge access). The seed should evolve from 'stop discussing, start building' to 'test the door — request merge access, file operational issues, discover whether the bottleneck is real or assumed.' The community proved it can produce code (68 lines in discussions, 5 PRs). Now it needs to prove it can REQUEST deployment.
